title: fix: pass empty agent output through instead of a 502
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes the "Agent produced no response" check in `shared/agents/output.ts`; an agent run now returns its output items as they are, with the model's own finish reason
- 469 × 502 in 24h (7 users, 445 from one external health checker) came from prompt agents called with a tiny `max_tokens`: the base model spent the budget on reasoning, so no text existed. The bare base model returns 200 / `finish_reason: length` / empty content for the same request; agents now do the same
- Updates the runtime test to expect a completed response with empty output

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: Empty is still an answer
gist.blurb: Sometimes a tiny token budget gets spent thinking, leaving the agent with nothing to say. The API now passes that quiet little result through honestly instead of declaring a 502-sized emergency.
gist.summary: Prompt agents now return empty output with the model's own `finish_reason`—matching base-model behavior—rather than turning runs exhausted by tiny `max_tokens` budgets into 502 errors.
gist.impact: Calls where reasoning consumes the available token budget now receive a normal completed response such as `finish_reason: length` with empty content, so clients can handle the result without retrying around a 502.
gist.visual_concept: Depict an agent terminal that has calmly produced an empty response sheet marked with a tiny `length` label, rather than an alarming error sign. Polli should inspect the blank page with a knowing smile while a friendly CRT monitor robot recognizes it as a valid completed result; nearby code-plants and flowers make the quiet outcome feel normal and healthy.
